_notes: Symmetric Castilian Spanish contrast pairs — after an answer whose `pattern` matches a key, 70% probability the next question is drawn where `pattern === counterpart`, if available and unseen this session. Disabled in bosses and review mode. Pattern keys must exist in es/taxonomy.json. ser-vs-estar gets multiple symmetric pairs because it is the single highest-value contrast for Spanish learners; pretérito indefinido vs imperfecto is the past-tense headliner; por vs para covers the headline preposition contrast; subjuntivo vs indicativo is split across presente, cuando+futuro, and imperfecto/pluscuamperfecto for hypotheticals.
_design_notes: ser-vs-estar gets 4 symmetric flavors: identidad↔estado, adjetivo↔origen, localización↔evento, plus estar+gerundio paired one-way against ser-identity (highlights the structural distinction).

Pretérito indefinido ↔ imperfecto is the past-tense headliner; perfecto-pasado-reciente and perfecto-vs-indefinido one-way pair with indefinido to surface the Castilian peninsular usage of pretérito perfecto for today/this-week.
Subjuntivo pairs split: presente-duda↔voluntad (trigger families), cuando-futuro↔conjuncion (temporal vs concessive), imperfecto↔pluscuamperfecto (hypothesis types 2 and 3).
Por vs para gets symmetric pairs for causa↔finalidad and medio↔destinatario, plus a one-way para-fecha-limite → por-causa to expose the temporal flavor.
Vosotros vs ustedes captures the Castilian formal/informal plural split; tu-vs-usted ↔ vosotros-coloquial exposes the registration choice in peninsular Spanish.
Si-conditional pairs: real↔irreal and tipo3↔irreal (one-way) cover the three condicional patterns with the irreal as pivot.
